description: Master log of structured intelligence signals extracted from Daily Steel Structure Briefs.

signals.headline: Micron selects Bechtel for the first phase EPC of its New York semiconductor megafab
signals.steelRelevance: Large industrial buildings, utility racks, cleanroom support steel, equipment platforms, pipe supports, secondary steel, modular supports, and high-tolerance fabrication.
signals.followUpAction: Track Bechtel procurement channels, package split, structural steel subcontracting, modularization strategy, MEP rack packages, and local supply-chain outreach in New York.

signals.headline: Technip Energies wins Coral Norte FLNG EPCIC contract offshore Mozambique
signals.steelRelevance: Module steel, process skids, pipe supports, equipment support frames, offshore coating systems, lifting lugs, access steel, and integration supports.
signals.followUpAction: Track module fabrication strategy, yard selection, subcontracting model, Eni partner approvals, marine logistics, and heavy-lift schedule.

signals.headline: Bechtel advances Cheniere Sabine Pass Train 7 into EPC phase under LNTP
signals.steelRelevance: LNG module steel, pipe racks, equipment supports, flare and OSBL structures, access steel, coating, fireproofing, and Gulf Coast logistics capacity.
signals.followUpAction: Track FID, FERC conditions, full NTP, procurement package release, module yard activity, and Cheniere-Bechtel supplier engagement.

signals.headline: McDermott says QatarEnergy North Field East work continued through regional disruption
signals.steelRelevance: Offshore platforms, subsea support structures, pipe racks, logistics, marine transport, and site integration risk around Qatar LNG expansion.
signals.followUpAction: Track Strait of Hormuz shipping normalization, Ras Laffan repair priorities, McDermott offshore milestones, Technip-led onshore LNG train progress, and schedule knock-on effects.

signals.headline: Commonwealth LNG gives Technip Energies FNTP for 9.5 MTPA modular LNG project
signals.steelRelevance: Modular steel supports, pipe racks, equipment structures, shipping frames, lifting points, fabrication jigs, coating, and interface control.
signals.followUpAction: Watch modular package release, fabrication yard selection, procurement timing, transport route constraints, and quality documentation requirements.

signals.headline: Opportunity: advanced manufacturing and AI infrastructure are becoming steel-intensive growth markets
signals.steelRelevance: Industrial buildings, MEP rack, access steel, secondary steel, embedded plate, equipment platform, and modular support capability.
signals.followUpAction: Track data center zoning, power availability, EPC/construction partners, prefabricated MEP rack packages, substation work, and local contractor qualification.

signals.headline: Risk: Gulf logistics and LNG schedule uncertainty require stronger delivery buffers
signals.region: Middle East / Global LNG supply chain
signals.steelRelevance: Sea freight, heavy-lift availability, coating repair windows, storage, documentation, and expediting buffers.
signals.followUpAction: Monitor Hormuz shipping, Qatar LNG repair priorities, EPC schedule updates, offshore installation campaigns, and procurement instructions from main contractors.

signals.headline: Follow Bechtel's two-track industrial workload: LNG in Louisiana and semiconductor manufacturing in New York
signals.steelRelevance: Capability positioning for LNG modules, industrial buildings, cleanroom support steel, MEP racks, heavy coating, fireproofing, and export logistics.
signals.followUpAction: Prepare a target-client list covering Bechtel, Technip Energies, McDermott, data center builders, semiconductor EPC partners, and local package contractors.
